description: Locale configuration for Arabic (Libya) in Moment.js, defining date/time formats, relative time strings, and locale-specific parsing/formatting functions.

methods.name: pluralForm
methods.description: Determines the plural form index based on the number for Arabic (Libya).

methods.name: pluralize
methods.description: Returns the correct pluralized string for a given time unit based on the number.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Determines if the meridiem indicator corresponds to PM.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the meridiem indicator ('ص' or 'م') based on the hour.

methods.name: preparse
methods.description: Preprocesses input string by removing Unicode right-to-left mark and replacing Arabic comma.

methods.name: postformat
methods.description: Formats output string by replacing Latin digits with Arabic-Indic digits and replacing comma with Arabic comma.
